doc: Rebirth/Documentation/research/RE-wheelie-polish.md (the mileage TopUI section, pass WHEELIETOP, both databases; the bytes in its entry-byte tables and addenda)

facts.name: SBScooterCoordinator_RequestTopUIAssets(coord)
facts.note: Once per latch (+0x1FD): the asset request for the Wheelie_Top package with a callback that creates the counter widget into coord+0x40, hidden. Reads nothing but the latch; safe outside the tick.

facts.name: SBScooterCoordinator_CloseTopUI(coord)
facts.note: RemoveFromParent, the weak cleared, the package released, the latch cleared. Called, never redirected in place (its entry crosses a block in both builds).

facts.name: SBScooterCoordinator_Tick_Vt280's CloseTopUI call (the list-empty branch)
facts.note: 1.004 E8 75 CB 24 00 at %16=2, 1.005 E8 75 39 25 00 at %16=2, both inside one block; under `count <= 0 && +0x40 valid`, the only statement of that branch. The other caller is the Disable slot's tail jump (left to the game).
